notes._policy: Version 1 allowlist for Plan 4: user and user_connection sync with the same save timing and persistence requirements. Oversized uploads fail without dropping values; any storage write failure disables sync for the page. All other scopes and unclassified keys stay local. Prefixes end in *; exact entries override prefixes, then the longest prefix wins. The encrypt list alone chooses which exported keys the API seals; the backend knows no setting names. Classification does not itself change any upstream writer.
notes._extraction: The guard conservatively inventories all settings data-name values and quoted *_ concatenations, including buttons, translation/metric identifiers and a commented country_ expression. These non-storage fragments are classified locally and documented below; they do not authorize export.
notes._variable_keys: Audited variable consumers: Timeline.filename returns file_view or file_view_<active CUB profile>; Tracker builds account_timeline_sync_<profile>; ContentRows builds content_rows_<installed row name>; WorkerArray builds storage_<field>_update_time. Generic Params/Input names resolve through registered settings; player_need selects player/player_iptv/player_torrent. Plugin {storage_<key>} interpolation, Console enumeration and remote configuration can access arbitrary keys: unclassified keys remain local.
notes._cub_storage_sync: Storage.init registers online_view, torrents_view, search_history, online_last_balanser, user_clarifys and torrents_filter_data. WorkerArray/Object write through Storage.set on CUB fetch/socket updates and send changes via socket plus storage/update when CUB sync/premium is enabled. Plan 4 does not coordinate CUB writers: overlapping keys use last-save-wins behavior; torrents_filter_data remains cache despite CUB sync.
notes._cub_backup: CUB Backup.publish serializes all localStorage except app.js to users/backup/export; inject restores arbitrary returned keys through localStorage.setItem then reloads. This manual whole-device backup can replace every user, connection and external key, independently of Storage.sync. The next Plan 4 boot GET reapplies non-dirty server values and preserves dirty local edits; this file governs Svtlv sync only and does not restrict CUB backup.
notes.favorite: Must-sync local Favorite document contains bookmarks, likes, history, viewed and thrown categories plus cards. With CUB Permit.sync, mutations route to bookmarks/add/remove/clear and rendering uses CUB Bookmarks; the synced local document is unused in that mode. CUB caches/trackers stay external.
notes.file_view: Synced durable local playback positions, duration and percent. Timeline uses this unsuffixed key when CUB sync is off; the synced local document is unused while CUB progress sync is active. CUB first-profile initialization may copy it into the active profile key.
notes.file_view_*: External durable progress partitioned by CUB profile id. Account.Timeline imports timeline/dump/changelog and sends timeline/update for the active profile. Never enumerate, export or import CUB-profile progress through Svtlv sync, or treat its suffix as a Keycloak id.
notes.language: Portable interface/content language: Lang selects the dictionary and several catalog consumers use it. Keyboard layout and keyboard_default_lang remain device-specific; importing language must not replace those explicit device choices.
notes.tmdb_lang: Portable catalog metadata, artwork-logo and search language sent to TMDB. Does not configure a player, keyboard or endpoint.
notes.mine_reactions: Local map of reactions selected for media ids. Reaction submissions use the generated device lampa_uid; importing this map must not replay votes or synchronize that uid.
notes.online_last_balanser: Synced per-title online-provider choices, not credentials. Registered with CUB Storage.sync as object_string; plugins can supply its consumer. Missing providers are tolerated; overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.online_view: Synced watched online hashes; CUB Storage.sync array_string also writes it. Overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.online_watched_last: Synced last-viewed episode/voice history, used by card episode/continue logic. Storage.cache only bounds its size; no dedicated CUB Storage.sync registration.
notes.person_subscribes_id: User subscription ids, also written from CUB person/list and person/subscribe/unsubscribe responses. Importing local ids must not create remote subscriptions or overwrite the currently selected CUB account.
notes.search_history: Synced portable search history; CUB Storage.sync array_string also writes it. Overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.torrents_view: Synced watched torrent identifiers, despite Storage.cache calls. CUB Storage.sync array_string also writes it; overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.user_clarifys: Synced search-title clarifications keyed by media id; CUB Storage.sync object_object also writes it. Overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.plugins: Device-local executable plugin URLs/configuration. Installed scripts can require platform APIs; first sync release must never install code from another device. CUB also supplies a separate account_plugins list.
notes.plugins_blacklist: Device-local plugin suppression list; keep aligned with this device's executable scripts, never import from another platform.
notes.menu_sort: Device menu ordering depends on installed plugins/features; keep local.
notes.menu_hide: Device menu visibility depends on installed plugins/features; keep local.
notes.start_page: Device startup target may refer to unavailable plugin components or last activity; keep local.
notes.content_rows*: ContentRows SettingsApi/Storage dynamically append row names to content_rows_. Visibility depends on installed feature providers; keep device-local. Guarded through the literal content_rows base.
notes.account_timeline_sync*: CUB Tracker adds _<profile id> to account_timeline_sync; stores remote version/time, not playback progress. Never export as user data.
notes.account_bookmarks_*: CUB profile-specific IndexedDB bookmark snapshots, not the local favorite document. Keep service-owned. Exact account_bookmarks_sync is the CUB version/time tracker.
notes.account_bookmarks_sync: CUB IndexedDB version/time tracker. Excluded from user data; guarded manually because tracker_name is passed by variable.
notes.account_bookmarks: Legacy CUB bookmark key still cleared on account reset/cache clearing; service-owned, never imported as local favorites.
notes.account: CUB token, identity and selected profile; separate from Keycloak. All account_* state is service-owned, not Svtlv user identity.
notes.cloud_token: Third-party cloud credential registered by Params; never export or conflate with Keycloak.
notes.cloud_use: Third-party cloud integration toggle tied to that device's cloud credential.
notes.terminal_access: Terminal.getAccess grants a generated remote-terminal credential; remain local, never a user preference.
notes.discuss_voited: Local remembered discussion votes after remote CUB discussion voting. Service-associated feedback state; excluded from initial Svtlv export.
notes.cub_domain: Selected CUB service mirror endpoint, separate from Svtlv account. Device-local connection.
notes.cub_mirrors: Device-supplied CUB mirror list read directly from localStorage.
notes.cub_alive: Generated last reachable CUB base URL from mirror failover, not a portable endpoint preference.
notes.cub_screensaver: Selected CUB video wallpaper URL consumed by the device screensaver; remain device-specific despite remote source.
notes.cub_theme: Device-selected CUB appearance extension; remain local with other rendering options.
notes.torrserver_url: Portable primary TorrServer endpoint; both URLs sync while each device selects its active link locally.
notes.torrserver_auth: Shared authentication toggle for both portable TorrServer URLs; sync with the shared credentials.
notes.torrserver_login: Must-sync shared TorrServer username for both URLs. Listed in encrypt so the API seals it in place; encryption policy is owned only by this file.
notes.torrserver_password: Must-sync shared TorrServer password for both URLs. Listed in encrypt so the API seals it in place; encryption policy is owned only by this file.
notes.torrserver_savedb: Controls whether playback writes a saved torrent into this TorrServer and records ownership. Connection-local behavior, not an account connection field.
notes.torrserver_preload: Stream preload behavior for the current TorrServer/device path; remain connection-local.
notes.torrserver_gts: Use TorrServer-provided streaming path when supported; depends on the configured server/client.
notes.parse_lang: Torrent-title search language used by the selected parser, separate from TMDB metadata/interface language; keep with the local parser connection.
notes.source: Catalog service choice (TMDB/CUB), tied to available service integrations; local connection selection.
notes.protocol: Service request scheme and CUB login retry preference; device/network-specific, not the language/content preference.
notes.setting_member: Input.edit remembers user-entered connection values/URLs across settings, potentially credentials. Exclude from export; never treat as benign history.
notes.parental_control_pin: Device parental PIN; keep local with that device's parental controls, never user data.
notes.parental_control_time: Device PIN-unlock timeout/state, not portable preference.
notes.player_normalization_*: Runtime normalization power/smooth/type settings depend on player/device. Also catches translation fragments; exact device settings remain explicit.
notes.player_segments_*: Per-segment ad/skip control dynamically builds player_segments_<type>; device playback behavior. Also catches translation fragments.
notes.player_normalization_step_*: Player translation fragment, excluded from export.
notes.player_normalization_type_*: Player translation fragment, excluded from export.
notes.player_segments_value_*: Player translation fragment, excluded from export.
notes.player_size_*: Player translation fragment, excluded from export; player_size itself is a device rendering choice.
notes.developer_*: Developer switches dynamically use developer_<name>; stay device-local. Exact developer_enabled and developer_nopremium remain explicit.
notes.storage_*: CUB WorkerArray dynamically builds storage_<field>_update_time; generated sync cursor, never user data.
notes.lampa_uid: Generated reaction/device identity; never propagate to another device.
notes.lampa_*: IndexedDB database-name fragment, not a storage user document. Exact lampa_uid stays generated cache state.
notes.region: Detected network geo result plus timestamp used for proxy selection; regenerated on each device.
notes.remote_helper: Device remote-control help display timestamps, not user history.
notes.torrents_filter: Last selected parser result filter fallback on this device; keep local with parser availability, not portable watch history.
notes.torrents_sort: Device parser-result sorting; remain local in the first sync release.
notes.torrents_filter_data: Per-card parser result filters bounded by cache; CUB Storage.sync object_object also updates it. Excluded despite that remote writer.
notes.recomends_list: Generated recommendation candidates derived from history, regenerate instead of exporting.
notes.recomends_scan: Recommendation scan bookkeeping, not actual watched history.
notes.ser_clarifys: Legacy cache-clear key without current read/write consumers; guarded through its literal in the clear list.
notes.timetable: Generated episode schedule/cache derived from favorites and metadata; rebuild on this device.
notes.add: Settings button data-name, not a persisted preference; classified device-only defensively.
